slides.label: WHY START HERE
lines: Every rebooking email needs one thing first: a list of the people who already hunted with you.
Most outfitters have it. It's just scattered across texts, emails and a notebook.

slides.label: STEP 1
slides.title: Pull it into one place
items: Your guest book or camp sign-in sheet

slides.label: STEP 2 · THE COLUMNS THAT MATTER
items: The only two you can't skip.
So your note can mention a real person.
The bull on day four, the long pack out, the weather.

slides.label: STEP 3 · KEEP IT USEFUL
items: Add each hunter after the hunt
While you still remember the details.
So you don't send the same ask twice.
Only email people who hunted with you or asked to hear from you.

slides.label: THE PAYOFF
lines: A real list lets you send a real thank-you, a real rebooking email and a real reminder before the draw.
That is how a past hunter turns into next season's booking.
